sampling: Three unchanged suites, two resource modes, five fixed baseline/candidate blocks; 4096 time inputs or 1000 allocation inputs. Twelve preflights precede 60 measurement processes. All builds are terminal before probes.
checks: Seven new tests pass on the unchanged baseline; the candidate passes 870 scalar library results, 28 doctests, strict Clippy, formatting and warning-denied docs. Focused test totals overlap the full suite.
limits: Block ratios pair each candidate with the baseline in the same fixed block; this is a new two-variant design, not additional samples for any earlier experiment.
Ratios and directions are descriptive, without statistical-significance or application-speedup claims. Every range and adverse row is retained.
Requested Rust allocations exclude native C heaps; retained and peak counters are phase-relative and do not prove eventual reclamation.
Probe binary sizes are not production executable size. Native consumers, full reports, broader/default/feature qualification and original limits remain open.
